summary: Extended the automatic runtime analyzer so the next Quest 3/VDXR validation can distinguish each stage of the already-implemented DXVK host-owned shared-eye transport: host allocation/publication, game-side KMT import, host/game generation agreement, explicit host-owned direct-path selection, and fallback. This is diagnostics-only and does not change rendered pixels, transport ownership, cadence or OpenXR submission.

review.architecture: The current host-owned shared-eye transport source 54be06b4 remains unchanged. This task observes its existing host/game log contract rather than adding another transport implementation.
review.lifetime_sync: Generation identity is surfaced as DxvkHostBridgeGeneration, DxvkHostImportGeneration and DxvkHostGenerationMatches so stale/cross-generation evidence can be distinguished in the next runtime bundle.
review.stereo_correctness: No world/HUD/menu/stereo draw path changed. A status can report transport activation only when the existing host-owned path log is observed and DirectFrames is greater than zero.
review.performance: No pacing optimization is claimed. The analyzer preserves directFrames/fallbacks/XR timing evidence and only makes the transport stage responsible for a future failure easier to locate.
review.adversarial: Bridge-ready alone is explicitly not treated as success. Separate statuses cover host allocation failure, bridge ready but import unobserved, game import failure, and direct path active with frames.

behavior_verified: DXVK_HOST_OWNED_IMPORT_NOT_ESTABLISHED: host bridge ready + gameplay fallbacks + no game import.
DXVK_HOST_OWNED_IMPORT_FAILED: explicit game-side host-owned KMT eye import failure.
DXVK_HOST_OWNED_DIRECTGPU_ACTIVE: host bridge ready + game import ready + host-owned path selected + DirectFrames > 0.
DxvkHostGenerationMatches is produced when both host and game import generations are observed.
Existing shared-probe failure classification and directFrames/fallback extraction remain covered by the same behavior test.
regression_revalidation: VR-DXVK-D3D9EX-SHARED-HANDLE-001: remains OPEN_USER_RUNTIME_VERIFIED_FAILURE because no new HMD/game execution occurred.
Current host-owned shared-eye transport remains Quest3/VDXR runtime-unverified; this task only improves evidence classification.
